project_info.theme: Lip shade comparison for YSL The Slim
project_info.color_palette: Bronze-gold gradient, nude beige skin tones, warm terracotta, burnt orange-red

main_subject.detail: Extreme close-up of a female mouth with slightly parted lips and white teeth, split vertically by a thin white divider line to compare two lipstick shades. Top headline reads '#1936 - FIERY ERA' and bottom copy reads 'ĐỎ CAM GẠCH CÁ TÍNH'.
main_subject.style: Luxury beauty macro, precise lipstick swatch-comparison poster, matte texture focused

composition_elements.text: #1936 - FIERY ERA, ĐỎ CAM GẠCH CÁ TÍNH
items: Top Left: Bronze gradient header field
Top Right: Large bold white typography '#1936 - FIERY ERA'
Bottom Left: Muted nude-terracotta matte lip tone on the left half
Bottom Right: Stronger burnt brick-orange matte lip tone on the right half
Center/Background: Full-frame lip macro with a thin vertical white comparison line and oversized white footer text 'ĐỎ CAM GẠCH CÁ TÍNH'

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Even frontal light, crisp matte lip texture, delicate skin detail, smooth tonal transitions, no dramatic shadowing

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square luxury beauty shade-comparison poster for YSL. Centerpiece is an extreme close-up of a female mouth with slightly parted lips and visible white teeth, divided by a thin vertical white line to compare two matte lipstick tones. Left side is a softer nude-terracotta matte shade, right side is a more saturated burnt brick-orange matte shade. Include the exact text '#1936 - FIERY ERA' at the top and 'ĐỎ CAM GẠCH CÁ TÍNH' at the bottom in bold white typography. Background is a warm bronze-gold gradient field. Technical style: photoreal beauty macro advertising composite, soft studio beauty lighting, crisp matte lip texture and delicate skin detail, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

assets.name: Female lip macro reference
assets.usage: Preserve the exact mouth shape, visible teeth, fair skin texture, and tight crop

assets.name: YSL lipstick shade #1936 Fiery Era

assets.name: Comparison poster typography layout

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Maintain a cosmetic-comparison look with sharp lip texture and very clean typography. Do not stylize into editorial fashion imagery or change the central crop.
